title: Card on file updated
description: Event generated when card on file is updated. The Update card on file endpoint generates this event.

card_name.title: Card name
card_name.description: Cardholder name printed or embossed on card.

card_profile.title: Card profile or color theme
card_profile.description: Used to render the color or card image in a payment app. Can be either a hex HTML color or the name of a network profile registered with the network.

created_at.title: Created date time
created_at.description: Date/time (RFC3339 format) when card on file was created and added to customer's wallet.

default_card.title: Default card flag
default_card.description: Is this the cardholder's default card flag.

issuer_card.title: Issuer card flag
issuer_card.description: Is this the issuer's card flag.

last_4_digits.title: Last 4 PAN digits
last_4_digits.description: Last four PAN (primary account number) digits

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Card metadata. Client-created - no business rule validation is done.

org.title: Org ID
org.description: Organization ID, also known as the Tenant ID.

printed_name.title: Card name
printed_name.description: Card name printed or embossed on card.
